summary: Reproduced the expert-distribution recorder pass-boundary GPU-to-host synchronization failure during a real gfx950 graph capture, then skipped only pass-boundary bookkeeping while capture is active. Per-layer hooks remain active and capturable.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual HIP graph capture entered _ExpertDistributionRecorderReal._on_forward_pass_end and failed at the fixture accumulator's device Tensor.item() with hipErrorStreamCaptureUnsupported; raw log: reports/j-73c627c52241/raw/gpu_repro_before.log

Four regression and boundary cases: capture skips start/end bookkeeping, eager recording retains bookkeeping, disabled recording remains a no-op, and capture retains per-layer hooks; raw log: reports/j-73c627c52241/raw/unit_tests.log
The previously failing actual gfx950 graph capture completed because pass-end bookkeeping was not entered; raw log: reports/j-73c627c52241/raw/gpu_repro_after.log

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-73c627c52241/venv/bin/python inline captured-hook replay check
tests.what_was_measured: A recorder per-layer hook captured a device add and two graph replays produced 4.0, matching the independent arithmetic reference 2 * 2.0; raw log: reports/j-73c627c52241/raw/gpu_hook_replay.log

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 GPU was used for the failing-before capture, passing-after capture, and captured-hook replay. No full model was loaded.

remaining_limitations: The reported GLM-5.2 NVFP4 weights and 8x NVIDIA B200 TP8 environment were unavailable, so full EAGLE/MTP server startup and multi-node behavior were not reproduced.
The single-GPU fixture validates the exact recorder boundary and HIP graph-capture failure mechanism, not GLM model semantics or distributed collective behavior.
Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32106 is open and unmerged; this prepared base did not contain its guard.
